description_en: Queries statistics on the request volume for all subdomains of a specified domain name
description_zh: 查询指定域名下的全部子域名的请求量统计
name: DescribeRecordStatisticsSummary

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

The default value is en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：
zh：中文
en：英文

默认：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100, the minimum value is 1, and the default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，最小值为1，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The start date of the query. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

You can query data only from the last 90 days. The value of `StartDate` must be greater than or equal to the current date minus 90 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询的开始时间，格式：YYYY-MM-DD。

只能查询最近90天的记录，即：`StartDate >= Now - 90。`
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en:
The end date of the query. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

The default value is the current day
parameters.help_zh:
查询的结束时间。格式：YYYY-MM-DD。

默认为查询当天的时间
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The search mode for the keyword. Valid values:

LIKE: fuzzy search (default)

EXACT: exact match
parameters.help_zh:
关键词的搜索模式。取值：

模糊搜索（默认）：LIKE
精确搜索：EXACT
parameters.name: search_mode

parameters.help_en: The keyword. The search is performed in the %KeyWord% format and is not case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh: 关键词，按照“%KeyWord%”模式搜索，不区分大小写
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The threshold for the number of DNS requests. This operation returns data for subdomains whose request count is less than or equal to this value.

If you set this parameter to 100, subdomains with a request count from 1 to 100 are returned.

If you leave this parameter empty, all subdomains that have DNS requests are returned.

If you set this parameter to 0, subdomains with no DNS requests are returned. If a domain name is added on the current day and has no requests, you can query its data on the next day
parameters.help_zh:
查询解析请求量不大于threshold的域名数据。取值为任意大于等于threshold值的整数。例如:
为100时，查询对应时间段内有解析请求量且小于等于100次的域名。
为空时，查询对应时间段内有解析请求量的全部域名。
为0时，查询对应时间段内无解析请求量的域名，如果是当天添加的域名且没有任何请求量，需要第二天才能查询到
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en:
The type of the domain name. This parameter is not case-sensitive. Valid values:

PUBLIC: authoritative domain name (default)

CACHE: proxy domain name
parameters.help_zh:
域名类型，大小写不敏感。取值： 

PUBLIC：权威托管域名（默认值）

CACHE：权威代理域名
parameters.name: domain_type

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

TotalItems.description_en: The total number of entries returned

TotalPages.description_en: The total number of pages returned
